flowNodes.title: Read Release Context
flowNodes.subtitle: Identify recent repository changes that can drive the video narrative.
flowNodes.markdown:
# Read Release Context

Use the Harness Agent Canvas repository as the source material for the video narrative.

Read either the local repository or the GitHub repository at https://github.com/mrayandika15/harness-agent-canvas when available in runtime context.

Focus only on commit history, repository-visible changes, and product-relevant context. Identify what is new, notable, user-facing, or suitable for a short release advertisement.

Return a concise handoff containing:

- Recent feature names or themes
- Commit references or short commit identifiers when available
- One-sentence value proposition for each feature
- Any uncertainty where commit messages or source context are unclear

Do not implement code, edit files, render video, run tests, execute the workflow, or inspect unrelated websites.

flowNodes.title: Capture Product Flow
flowNodes.subtitle: Inspect available local app behavior and translate it into structured video scenes.
flowNodes.markdown:
# Capture Product Flow

Use browser-use only for a local Harness Agent Canvas target that is already available in runtime context.

Do not ask the user to provide a URL. Determine and use an available local target when possible, such as an already running localhost app, a known project dev server URL, or a browser-use-accessible local page.

If no local app target is available, skip browser inspection and return a clear blocker instead of asking for input.

Inspect the visible product flow related to the recent repository changes and translate it into structured HTML-style scene input for a Remotion composition. The HTML should describe the advertisement sequence, not become production application code.

Return a handoff with:

- Local target used, or the blocker if no target was available
- Short scene-by-scene product flow
- Structured HTML sections for each scene
- Suggested on-screen copy
- UI states or interactions that should be shown
- Known gaps if inspection was unavailable

Do not inspect external websites. Do not run tests. Do not modify files.

flowNodes.title: Plan Remotion Ad
flowNodes.subtitle: Turn release findings and product flow into a concrete Remotion composition plan.
flowNodes.markdown:
# Plan Remotion Ad

Use the release-context findings and product-flow handoff as the creative brief for a Remotion advertisement.

Create a concrete Remotion composition plan for a new-feature release video.

Use safe defaults unless the user provided specifics:

- Format: 16:9 landscape
- Duration: 30-45 seconds
- Tone: polished product release advertisement
- Visual style: clean SaaS product demo with clear feature callouts
- Primary content: repository-derived new features and local app flow

Expected handoff:

- Composition name
- Scene order with durations
- HTML-to-Remotion mapping notes
- Animation direction
- Voiceover or caption copy when useful
- Asset assumptions
- Any blocker that would prevent implementation or rendering

Do not render the video in this step. Do not claim files were created unless the runtime confirms them.

flowNodes.title: Render And Verify MP4
flowNodes.subtitle: Render the finished Remotion advertisement only when runtime setup permits it.
flowNodes.markdown:
# Render And Verify MP4

Render the Remotion composition into an MP4 and place the output in `/generations` at the repository root only when rendering is explicitly part of the active workflow execution and the runtime setup permits it.

Use a deterministic filename such as:

`generations/new-features-ad.mp4`

Before reporting completion, verify:

- The MP4 exists in `/generations`
- The render completed without errors
- The video duration matches the planned composition
- The final output advertises the new features identified from repository context

If rendering is unavailable, blocked, unsafe, or the Remotion project is missing required setup, skip rendering and report the exact blocker in the final handoff.

Do not run tests or execute unrelated workflows.
